headline: Base Fronts Roil, Then Fall Quiet
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger has shifted from broad immediate turmoil to a mixed picture of sharp engagements and cooling fronts. Callums Cape remains the liveliest sector, with seven ownership events in the latest two hours and 36 across the day; its seven bases are split four to three between Wardens and Colonials. Mooring County has likewise quickened, posting six recent events and 18 in 24 hours, while Wardens hold 10 of 12 bases, one Colonial position and one neutral. By contrast, Linn Mercy, Weathered Expanse and Godcrofts have gone quiet in the last two hours after earlier churn, though their daily records still show 23, 23 and seven events respectively. Nevish Line has no fresh event in the immediate window but retains 39 for the day, with all eight bases Colonial-held. Callahans Passage also shows no movement in two hours, yet its 10 daily events accompany the heaviest current casualty rates outside the major contested sectors. Most other regions remain static or only lightly active, leaving ownership volatility concentrated in a handful of fronts.
